name: Eastroc Beverage (Group) Co.,Ltd.
summary: Eastroc Beverage (Group) Co.,Ltd. is a Chinese company specializing in the production of various drinks. Its extensive product lineup features items such as the Dongpeng vitamin functional drinks, Mandarin lemon tea, Dongpeng Jiayi, Chen pit drink, and Dongpengshui. This firm, which was established in 1994, operates from its main office situated in Shenzhen, China.
